rulings: CF-A-NAMED-SPECIALIZATION-IS-ITS-OWN-PRODUCT (#1715 class, 2026-09-07). Panini Haunted Hoops is a DISTINCT PRODUCT from Panini NBA Hoops -- its own 300-card checklist, its own parallels (Slime, Holo Bats, Holo Webs, Holo Trick-or-Treat), its own market. It is ruled a normalizeSetKey fixed point in this PR and mirrored into the SPECIALIZATION-STATED ladder. These sales are priced inside the flagship pool because the family word in the specialization s own name swallowed it.

THE VEHICLE WAS CHOSEN BY MEASUREMENT, NOT BY PREFERENCE, AND MOST ROWS ARE NOT IN THIS FILE. The classifier was run LOCALLY over all 4,653 stranded pool rows with the new ladder edge in place: 3,057 (65.7%) QUALIFY for SPECIALIZATION-STATED and need no list -- the rematch moves them under scope=improve once this PR ships. The remaining 1,596 are refused, every one on the SAME leg, L2 title-does-not-state:panini. This list is exactly that residue: 1,595 entries, the one flaggedWrong row excluded.

THE REFUSAL IS CORRECT AND IS NOT BEING WEAKENED. L2 requires every distinguishing word of the derived key to appear in the title. `panini-haunted-hoops` carries the maker word; these titles do not ("2024-25 Hoops Haunted Hoops #193 LeBron James Holo Webs"). Loosening L2 would loosen it for every product on the ladder, so the guard stands and the named residue moves by a reviewed list of ids -- which is the vehicle this exact situation is for.

EVERY ROW IN THIS LIST STATES THE PRODUCT IN ITS OWN TITLE. All 1,596 refused titles literally contain "Haunted Hoops" -- 1,596 of 1,596, verified. No row is moved on a setName, a stored field or an inference; the sale s own words name the product.

TWO SHAPES, DECIDED BY WHERE THE SLUG LIVES -- and the split is why this list is not one shape. sold_comps partitions on /cardId, and 590 of these CardHedge rows carry a VENDOR cardId ("1728274951582x122642337620927790") with the hiq slug only in hobbyiqCardId. Those are REPOINT: the partition is not wrong, the field the pricing engine reads is, so they are patched in place. The other 1,005 carry a hiq slug AS the cardId and are genuine RELOCATE -- a wrong partition, moved by relocateSoldComp. Each entry names exactly ONE shape; verified 0 entries naming two.

RELOCATE AND REPOINT ONLY -- NOTHING IS RETIRED OR PARKED. Every entry moves a real sale to the address of the card it is a sale of. The single flaggedWrong row among the 1,596 is EXCLUDED rather than moved: a row already marked wrong is not this list s to adjudicate.
